title: CI: re-enable farm tests in GitHub Actions
body:
Farm tests (`test/farm/`) were skipped during the Cirrus-to-GHA CI migration due to time pressure. This re-enables them by adding a `run_farm()` function in `hack/ci/runner.sh` that handles the extra setup farm tests need (sshd, loginctl enable-linger, and starting the rootless podman socket via SSH to localhost), a `farm` job in `ci.yml` that runs rootless on `fedora-current` through the shared lima workflow, and a corresponding path filter so farm tests only trigger when `test/farm/` or shared system test helpers change.

- Fixes: #28833
